# Independent starter fixtures

These fixtures were authored without reading a starter implementation. They
specify expected behavior, not captured command output. Execution is pending.

| Fixture | Independent source and purpose |
| -- | -- |
| plan.yaml, preparation.yaml, seed.yaml | Literal small public invitation-reviewer fixtures, transcribed under0380. The raw plan hash is the reviewed reviewer-contract literal, not calculated from starter output. One required onboardee question deliberately remains unanswered. |
| begun.yaml | Record encoder field order/scalar rules and0230 event semantics; independently held fixed clock value2026-10-23T12:34:56.123Z. |
| existing.yaml | 0090/0380 exact no-op preservation; hand-ordered fields/comment/unknown notes and absent first event are intentional. It is not canonical encoder output. |
| first-steps.md | Literal original invitation guidance, not regenerated current guidance. |
| help.txt | Exact four-line terminal.md help grammar. |
| identity.txt | Exact terminal.md identity/privacy/destination block. At-sign placeholders substitute only owned ASCII sandbox paths; they are not arbitrary user-text escaping or a second display renderer. |
| fresh-review.txt | Exact terminal.md complete action/reconciliation/privacy block. The actual reconciler zero previous context supplies empty comparison lists, not fabricated new activity/question claims. Fixed Previous comparison problems label is the root-selected bounded P3/P7 presentation clarification. |
| session.txt | terminal.md full purposeful projection, reviewer TestLiteralNewSession independent section-hash/question/blocker/wrapped-warning literals, and0045/0120 unanswered marker. No renderer output was read. |
| full.plan.yaml, full.preparation.yaml | Independently authored schema-driven coverage for meaningful actual activity/step/check/environment/question/default/list/support fields, waiting Requires, goal dates and repeated helpers. Runtime placeholders name only the owned sandbox; source hashes are computed with standard SHA256 when framing the seed, never by a product dependency. Terminal-control payloads must be escaped, not executed or deleted. |
| stale.preparation.yaml | 0190/0380 retained stale support is preserved and marked unavailable, not passed to valid-only support use or silently replaced. Unknown personal markers must not be displayed. |
| stale-session.txt | Exact terminal.md session projection with stale.preparation.yaml's five ordered repair errors, derived from the reviewer contract rather than captured output. Support is false, with no contradictory true claim. |

Archive helpers use standard ZIP Store solely to frame these independent bytes.
Runtime-dependent absolute paths, native identities and cryptographic transaction
tokens are not fixed fixture constants. Tests independently derive the specified
length-framed session key and inspect actual filesystem objects. They never use
a product decoder or renderer to manufacture expected bytes.

recovery_test.go defines literal version1 protocol schemas independently from
storage.md. Dynamic native facts are read only from owned sandbox objects. The
complete pending/owner/publication/receipt are not captured starter output.
recovery_boundaries_test.go coherently updates raw pending and owner/claim hashes
when mutating a field, preventing accidental outer-digest masking. The safe
canonical base64 Uwo= means S followed by LF; Uwp= has the same decoded bytes but
nonzero unused pad bits. Omitting afterBase64 is distinct from an empty payload.

publication_test.go changes a frozen record proposal only by an independently
literal YAML comment, pins0400/0600/0644 and an owned hard-link anchor, and does
not use an encoder to derive expected bytes. These seeded valid states test
recovery semantics, not process-death generation of those states. Real native
interruption evidence remains separately planned and must be reported by phase.

context_test.go's valid128/129pair independently length-frames different valid
synthetic accounts and actual distinct owned roots. Every registration has valid
literal plan/metadata and distinct record/preparation destinations. Malformed
names are a separate control and cannot supply inclusive-bound evidence.

staging_test.go authors the finite claim states from storage.md, including shared
missing parents and an unchanged claimed payload inode whose controls move from
initial0600 to exact intended0400. It neither injects a filesystem nor observes
product staging to decide expected ownership. Alternate group coverage uses only
the caller's own actual supplementary groups; unsupported hosts report a gap.

security_darwin_test.go reads native filesec through the documented Darwin
FGETATTRLIST shape; security_linux_test.go reads actual POSIX ACL xattrs. Native
absence is never guessed from mode bits. acl_darwin_test.go uses native
FSETATTRLIST to establish an explicit valid44-byte zero-entry filesec, independently
checks presence/count, and uses /bin/chmod only on owned sandbox objects for
actual deny-execute and inherited-read grants. A disposable0600control proves
inheritance before testing publication. ACL replacement is preserve-or-refuse;
retained no-op cannot require replacement capability.

process_test.go executes only the owned contract test binary's public starter
binding in a child process. Prompt handshakes prove real native exclusion and
release before session input. resources_darwin_test.go holds an additional hard
link to the old record inode while counting matching device/inode descriptors
through native Fstat; it does not stat /dev/fd directory entries or count unrelated
process descriptors.

interruption_darwin_test.go is a separately selected native observation layer.
Its twelve finite attempts per fresh, canonical0400reconciliation and retained
record profile SIGSTOP before independent persistent-state classification and
SIGKILL a newly reached strictly verified intended phase or a proved invariant
violation. Expected final
bytes are the original literal fixtures and independently specified registration,
not newly interpreted product output. Original native preimage/parent guards are
captured before the child starts. Each fixed-role prefix is distinguished;
out-of-order nonretained application is checked separately, and the no-op record with
unfinished companions has separately named coverage. Exact receipt role bodies,
native identities/security hashes and namespace binding are checked, not merely
version/length fields. A partial or unproved schema/guard is unclassified and
resumed, never killed as strict evidence. Unobserved phases remain explicitly
named gaps; no execution or process-death result is claimed by authorship.

The independent negative observer first proves role facts without requiring a
legal prefix. A later published role with a definite earlier preimage fails.
An attributed final receipt must have the exact public shape and proven native
facts; partial temporary receipts remain inconclusive. Completion-proof loss
requires unchanged same-child lineage and previously observed publication or
receipt facts, not a guessed history. Unknown native facts remain proof gaps.
observer_classification_darwin_test.go uses small owned-file data controls for
these distinctions. Those controls never call the starter and cannot establish
that a product variant reaches a forbidden state.

The existing-state supplementary-group fixture extends the same actual
Getgroups/Chown boundary as the record control. It preserves the exact preexisting
HOME/idle guards and separately requires new record/session objects to use the
effective native UID/GID. Ownership profile is the root-selected P4/P7 bounded
agent judgment, not human approval or normalization of original record controls.

The disposable setup base explicitly adopts the caller's effective GID before
creating its children. Darwin directory creation can inherit a parent group
outside the caller's permitted group set even when the caller owns the new
directory. This changes only the newly owned temporary base, not ambient TMPDIR,
ancestors, ACLs or the product's private-state admission rules. A failed Chown
fails fixture setup rather than skipping a positive control.

The full-session expected record retains the literal begun.yaml field order,
event and all other bytes. Its dynamic plan hash uses standard SHA256; only
that complete scalar's framing changes under the record encoder's public rule:
digit-leading hexadecimal is quoted, a-through-f-leading hexadecimal is plain.
Quoted seed input is valid even when noncanonical and remains unchanged. This
is a finite hexadecimal-scalar rule, not a product encoder oracle.

streams_test.go independently counts forbidden Close calls on borrowed input
and writers and verifies unused tails and continued caller use. Its paired
reader returns a positive count together with EOF or a nonEOF error at exact
identity/begin/exit boundaries, then proves that return was actually reached.
Complete EOF-framed actions follow ordinary consent; incomplete EOF does not.
NonEOF errors veto confirmation/begin and preserve completed truth after begin.
Exact literal display, complete record bytes and original snapshots remain the
oracles, not a simulated semantic dependency or an accepted alternate output.

The Darwin observer confirms Wait4's exact owned PID and native SIGSTOP status
before classifying persistent state. The installed SDK sys/wait.h defines a
stopped low-seven-bit marker0177 and the high-byte stop signal; SIGSTOP is17,
while SIGCONT19 is continuation. The observer checks the exact requested stop
rather than relying on the shared BSD Go helper's different continuation rule.
Bounded EINTR retries do not replace confirmation. No product or toolchain patch,
signal-send-only assumption or generic cross-platform wait implementation is used.

session_gaps_test.go pins the complete held step/check projection, including
escaped nonempty directory, argument lists, repeated escalation references and
multiline Ask with a trailing empty line. Its added contact declaration remains
in the full question list with onboarder audience; the walker and finder
contracts require both audiences in declaration order. The stale-support case
compares the entire completed session against stale-session.txt. Exact event,
session header and final prompt delimit that projection from the earlier review.

input_gaps_test.go distinguishes zero-byte/nil-error reads from ordinary EOF at
identity, review and completed-session boundaries. Literal padded/case-changed
confirm/begin/exit actions must repeat the current prompt, not gain consent.
Incomplete EOF fragments never count as actions. Independent reader counts and
untouched tails pin consumption; prebegin snapshots and complete postbegin bytes
pin effects. A64KiB bounded output writer prevents a wrong repeated-prompt loop
from turning captured output into unbounded memory growth.

protocol_gaps_test.go independently changes one inner recovery requirement while
updating the exact raw pending digests in owner/publication metadata. It pins
required empty keys, integer version, surrogate validity, base64 whitespace,
present-preimage digest, retained-proposal identity, parent ordinals and absent
ancestor closure. Malformed inputs must refuse before consuming consent, with
the whole namespace and every original native guard preserved. Canonical install,
retain, all-missing-parent and actual supplementary-Unicode root controls keep
those refusals distinct from rejecting every recovery. Expected bodies remain
literal fixtures and independently framed native metadata, not decoded output.

context_gaps_test.go pins exact account-case isolation, physical case-alias
reuse, explicitly reviewed incoming raw-hash changes and nested disjoint root/
home namespaces. The case-alias control must actually prove equal device/inode;
a case-sensitive volume explicitly reports unavailable coverage. A literal YAML
comment changes the incoming plan's raw hash without changing section semantics.
Complete held record/history bytes, old first-use event, scoped deferred answers
and unknown notes are preserved except the reviewed plan-reference hash. Native
guards, actual participant hard-link collision and cancellation snapshots pin
effects; expected metadata uses public length framing and standard JSON/SHA256.

resume_token_gaps_test.go uses two authored valid selector tokens and the existing
fixed report literals. A complete syntax-valid resume request retains its token
when no stored transaction has been identified and context verification refuses.
Missing home/namespace/root, symlink root and regular-file root controls use only
owned native fixtures. Invalid whole-CLI and initial-help controls preserve their
separate empty-transaction/no-report rules. Exact reader-call counts, untouched
tails, zero clock calls and complete namespace snapshots pin absence of consent
and changes. No recovery journal or report was captured to form an oracle, and
no token in a refusal claims existing or authorized recovery state.
